answer: The economy rotates a randomized grading panel each epoch: reputational quill credits are only minted when a majority of that round's anonymously sampled orchard of validators signs off, and the roster is re-drawn from a VRF pool every epoch. A sybil cannot know tomorrow's jury in advance, so to profit it must dominate a fresh ivory panel every round — colluding with fixed jurors never pays, and fake identities instead pay stake, compute, and committee duty each epoch while earning nothing, so attack cost scales with pool size.
